messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: p99 latency spike on /v1/generate (streaming). Detected at 15:12 UTC. SLOs breached, streaming stalls observed. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
sofia: seeing a lot of stalled streaming sessions, customers report partial transcripts then long silence. p95 ~200ms ok, p99 jumped to ~4.2s. :grimacing:
mike: initial look — auth DB (tokenstore) hitting a short-term rate window and configfetch fanout is spiking. Lots of 429s from config service. I can share a quick histogram.
sofia: customer impact: several high-throughput tenants experiencing client timeouts, some mobile SDKs mark session failed after 3s. sending CC to support.
beth: support: confirmed 3 enterprise customers complaining (Acme, NovaApps, Clearline). Acme has production traffic — impact: degraded streaming, some failed calls. Logged customer-facing incidents.
mike: logs snippet (auth errors + configfetch latency):
```
[15:12:05] auth-tokenstore request id=abcd-123 status=429 retry-after=2ms
[15:12:07] configfetch svc=cfgstore shard=42 latency=1500ms -> upstream timeout
[15:12:09] inference-gateway route=/v1/generate streaming stalled token_error=true
```
eli: ack. I'm oncall. tagging infra. tagging @jordan for night handoff if we go long.
sofia: quick mitigation ideas: 1) enable cached config fallback for routing, 2) temporarily increase tokenstore rate limits for internal controlplane, 3) fallback to n-1 model variant without config validation.
mike: agreed. root cause looks like a combination: a recent feature flag rollout caused extra config fanout per request (feature: dynamic-routing-v2). When control-plane load spikes, tokenstore rate windows kick in which then cascades to inference stalls.
devops-bot: Pager delivered to eli. Escalation level 2. Runbook: controlplane-throttle -> follow mitigation steps.
eli: executing mitigations now. 1) flip feature flag to off for global traffic, 2) bump tokenstore internal limit on tokenservice-prod for 10m, 3) enable config cache for inference-gw.
mike: commands I will run (will post results):
```
# disable feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://controlplane.internal/flags/dynamic-routing-v2/disable
# increase internal tokenstore window
kubectl exec -n infra tokenstore-ops -- ./tokenstorectl set-rate-limit --scope=internal --limit=12000
# enable local config cache on gateway (hot setting)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://gateway.internal/admin/cache?enable=true
```
eli: mike — after you flip the flag I'll start traffic steering to secondary auth cluster (`tokenstore-replica-2`) and warm KV cache.
sofia: on the customer side, support asked for ETA — can we give 15-30m?
beth: yes, telling customers "engineering is applying mitigations, ETA ~20m, will update in 10".
mike: disabled flag at 15:18 UTC — controlplane responded 200. Configfanout dropped in metrics already.
eli: tokenstore rate increase applied at 15:19 UTC. preliminary drop in 429s.
devops-bot: Metric alert cleared: auth-tokenstore-429-count <= threshold.
sofia: seeing improved streaming recovery for NovaApps and Clearline. Acme still has intermittent stalls, probably downstream cache warm.
mike: running a targeted replay on a sampled failing session to validate:
```
# replay session
python infra/tools/replay_session.py --session-id abcdef --target=gateway-prod
# result: streaming resumed, tail latency reduced to ~320ms
```
eli: switching routing to replica tokenstore for 5m window. Monitoring.
beth: customer comms updated. Acme on a short SLA note.
sofia: post-mortem action items: 1) revert aggressive fanout in dynamic-routing-v2 (rework design), 2) add circuit-breaker on configfetch per request, 3) add observable for feature-flag fanout multiplier, 4) increase warm cache for known enterprise tenants.
mike: adding an automated fallback in code to use last-known config when configfetch returns 5xx/429 for streaming paths. Also will add safety limit to per-request fanout.
eli: handoff in 30m to night oncall @jordan. I'll leave follow-up tasks in incident tracker and set severity to Sev2.
jordan: thanks — I'll take handoff at 16:00 UTC, please DM any open run commands.
sofia: closing loop: p99 back towards baseline (~550ms) after mitigations, streaming success rates improving. Will keep monitoring for 1h. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, customers affected: Acme (partial), NovaApps (recovered), Clearline (recovered). Severity: S2. Handoff scheduled to jordan at 16:00 UTC.
